title: Fall 2026
theme: Strategic: To be forewarned is to be forearmed
description: An 8-week tactical study of Biblical figures who fell to the schemes of the enemy. By analyzing their tactical errors, spiritual compromises, and blind spots, we learn how to guard our hearts, stand in the light, and beat back the devices of Satan.

weeks.title: Playing with Fire – Samson & Joseph

scripture.text: For whatsoever things were written in times past, were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the Scriptures might have hope.

outline: Examining the danger of not taking temptation seriously and the benefits of walking in the light.
Equipped to teach (families), to lead (other men), and to guide (counsel).
Both men raised in spiritual homes – are we living up to God's calling?
Sin is deceitful (Hebrews 3:12–13); all sin has a history (James 1:13–15).
Samson's troubles are self-inflicted: he couldn't master himself.
Samson flirts with trouble: he didn't tell her the truth because he knew she was trouble.
Samson refuses to take the way of escape (Judges 16:12; 1 Corinthians 10:12–13).
Keys to Joseph's Success – Stewardship: Someone who will give an account to another.
Keys to Joseph's Success – God's Total Authority: He is Lord, not just Savior. Temptation is always a battle for authority.
Keys to Joseph's Success – Conviction Established Early: What is right and wrong was decided before the temptation. Are we men under authority or will we make our own rules?
Keys to Joseph's Success – Integrity: What he believed, what he said, and what he did were consistent.
Keys to Joseph's Success – Healthy Fear of Himself: A time to run away (Matthew 5:27–32).
Keys to Joseph's Success – Healthy Fear of God: Recognizing 'great wickedness and sin against God' (Genesis 39:9) – not trying to justify or find a loophole.
questions: What stuck out to you from the two stories?
Where do you turn when living the Christian life and resisting the world becomes difficult?
What examples have you seen in your life of men who were like Samson or like Joseph – how did it impact you?
